title: Explicit tensor coordinates send a column map to its pulled-back column
statement: Let W,Y,T be schemes and t:T→W and s:T→Y morphisms. For Y-module sheaves M,N, isomorphisms q0:M≅O_Y and q1:N≅O_Y^(ULift(Fin m)), and δ:M→N, use the pinned tensor-unit map of [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf] and preservation of coproducts to define scalar and vector coordinates on Hom(t*O_W,s*M) and Hom(t*O_W,s*N). Explicitly conjugate with the pulled-back frames and unit/free comparisons, evaluate at 1 on the top open, and apply the finite-free section equivalence. For every raw morphism f, the vector coordinate of f followed by s*δ equals its scalar coordinate times the column obtained by applying s.appTop entrywise to the global-section column of q0 inverse followed by δ followed by q1. This holds for arbitrary T and Y and for m=0.

source.place: Tag 0096, tensor adjunction; Tag 01CA, pullback of the structure sheaf

proof.text: Construct the unit isomorphism by the pinned adjoint structure map. The tensor adjunction preserves coproducts, so mapFreeIso gives the normalized free isomorphism. Conjugation, unitHomEquiv, evaluation at top, and freeSectionsEquiv give explicit additive coordinate equivalences.

Apply the tensor adjunction to the square for a unit endomorphism. Naturality of homEquiv and its value on the tensor-unit map imply that its conjugate value at one is s.appTop applied to the original value at one.

Naturality of mapFreeIso on each free inclusion gives compatibility with each coordinate projection by the free coproduct universal property. Compose the column with those projections and apply the unit calculation.

Cancel the pulled-back frames in the composite f followed by s*δ. The remaining source-unit endomorphism has value a at one. Linearity multiplies the column by a; freeSectionsEquiv is linear. This proves the vector formula coordinatewise, including the empty vector.
